blocks.text: Algorithms masail hal karne ke qadam ba qadam tareeqe (procedures) hain, bilkul jaise recipe khana pakane ke qadam batati hai. Yeh computer science ki bunyad (backbone, reerh ki haddi) hain aur machines ko kaam efficiently (kam waqt aur wasail mein) karne ke qabil banate hain. Algorithms samajhna zaroori hai kyun ke software ke har kaam ke peeche inhi ki logic (mantiq) hoti hai; in se hum mushkil masail hal karte hain, performance behtar (optimize) karte hain aur mukhtalif applications mein durustagi (accuracy) yaqeeni banate hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Google search engine ek pecheeda algorithm PageRank istemal karta hai jo tay karta hai ke koi web page kitna mutaliq (relevant) hai. Yeh algorithm kai cheezein dekhta hai, jaise kisi page ki taraf aane wale links ki tadaad aur un links ka maeyar (quality), aur phir search results mein pages ki tarteeb (rank) banata hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Algorithms seekhte waqt unhein rozmarra ke un kaamon se jorein jo aap pehle se jante hain. Is se samajh aayega ke algorithms kaise kaam karte hain aur kyun ahem hain.

blocks.prompt: Recipe algorithm ki achhi misal kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Recipe saaf qadmon ki mehdood (finite) aur tarteeb wali list hai jo diye gaye inputs (ajza, ingredients) ko nateeje (khane) mein badalti hai; algorithm bhi yahi karta hai.

items: Algorithm: recipe jaisa qadam ba qadam tareeqa; PageRank links ki tadaad aur quality se web pages ki tarteeb banata hai.
